notes.title: Xmas Update 1.30
notes.content:
The Update long promised is finally available to download before Xmas ;)

[h2]NEW HORDE MAP : MINIONS MASSACRE[/h2]
A new Huge Indoor level for endless killing of mass groups of Zombies. Boost items excluded for added difficulty.

[h2]NEW HORDE MAP : HELL AWAITS[/h2]
Small defence map. 2 Gate Turrets are here to help you. New Item " Turret Upgrade" ( UP Arrow) for upgrading Turret damage deal. Beware turrets run out of ammunition, be sure to reload them ;-)

[h2]NEW ENEMIES : ZOMBIES[/h2]
All new 9 variations of zombies/animations waiting to be slaughtered in Minions Massacre!

[h2]GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/h2]
- Melee weapons received greater reach than before.
- All weapon have reduced spread = better accuracy
- Enemies that land a successful attack, will chase you faster

[h2]HITSCANS REWORKED[/h2]
Many have complaint in the past for hitscans from weapon firing not working as it should, which would miss point blank shots. The issue is resolved! ;-)

[h2]HEAVY OPTIMIZATIONS[/h2]
Finally made optimizations on all aspects of RIP. You may see raised FPS from 20%-50%! Textures also were reduced so you might get less vram required to render more crisp textures in game.

[h2]OTHER FIXES AND CHANGES[/h2]
- Dead Awaken map was re-polished
- Pause Menu was unreadable
- Switched from TAA to FXAA
- Main menu Music has boosted Bass and Slower Tempo
- AI freezing was improved
- Achievement Text were corrected

That's all! I really hope you enjoy! Rest In Pieces lads ;-)

ohhh. and Merry Christmas to everyone!

PS. Mac Update will be released tommorow. Also VR : Rest in Pieces update will be ported next days with many many improvements!

notes.title: Quality For Life - Update 1.15
notes.content:
[h1]New Update 1.15[/h1]

Focusing on quality for life(gameplay) and enviroment improvements.

[i]MacOS Update will be available tommorow.[/i]

[b]HORDE MODES[/b]

Be prepared for the upcoming new horde mode levels. UI was refined to welcome those new changes of the upcoming updates. The release day is not final yet but surely HELL AWAITS will be on mid/late November. As for MINIONS MASSACRE, is planned for early december. With those levels a total of 6 will be available!

[b]ENVIROMENT LIGHTING REWORKED[/b]

All missions lighting were reworked and changes were made for a more creapy feel. This changes were made according to new flashlight addition on weapons, described below.

[b]WEAPON FLASHLIGHTS[/b]

Removed the central flashlight, as it was a bit of for Project RIP and added flashlights attached on every weapon available. I must say this kind of atmosphere is just gorgeous :-)

[b]ADDED NEW PERK : SCAVENGER [/b]

A new Perk arrived! SCAVENGER, now all Boost PickUPs have a default startup time of 10 seconds and by using Scavenger with upgrades it can get to 22 seconds!!! As for second bonus stat, every other common pickup will be boosted for up to 25% !!!

[b]AIMING[/b]

Now aiming down the sights/scope or returning to hip view, is by far more responsive than before, matching the fast gameplay of Project RIP. You will notice a small delay in resposiveness when you run and trying to go into Aim Mode, this is clearly up to player to quickly release runmode before entering to Aim.

[b]WEAPON SKINS[/b]

Some skins were removed and some were added. In addition ALL weapon skins are now UNLOCKED by default, no need to grind for skins anymore! Also UI on Loadout and on Weapon Upgrade was refined to preview the Skins before play.

[b]OTHER ADDITIONS/CHANGES/FIXES[/b]

- Reworked Croped Corridor Crosses on Mission 2
- Added Fullscreen/Windowed Fullscreen/Windowed Options
- Fixed some Colissions
- Added Ronin Firing Slider Animation
- Added MetallicGear SFX on Player's Footsteps
- Reworked some incorrect UI elements
- Some UI elements were scaled down
- Added HUD Scaling/Opacity Options
- Added or corrected missing text elements for LanguagePack
- Removed OpenGL API from Linux version

That's all! Hope you really like this update! 
[i]If you Do happen to like Project R.I.P., please consider supporting the game by leaving a honest review.[/i]

As always Enjoy and... Rest In Pieces!!! ;-)
